title: Experts Explore Buddhist Heritage, Ancient Inscriptions and Archaeology at Bhopal’s Birla Museum
description: A two-day national lecture series on Buddhist heritage concluded at Bhopal’s Birla Museum, bringing together archaeologists and scholars to discuss ancient inscriptions, Buddhist sites, art, architecture and conservation. Experts presented research covering Bhopal, Bandhavgarh, Ujjain, Sanchi and Damoh, highlighting Madhya Pradesh’s extensive archaeological and cultural legacy.
